scope.summary: After the intentional killed-session DML case, the W4 driver starts a fresh MCP client at the lane's READ_ONLY baseline instead of sending a level drop to the dead session, so a full unscoped lane no longer aborts with 'failed to drop before profile switch'.
out_of_scope: Missing rel012 release-manifest scenarios (oraclemcp-bb5qm) and other red W4 cases.

entry_points.name: python3 scripts/e2e/w4/driver.py --lane <lane> (full unscoped lane, release binary)
entry_points.trace: Full unscoped lanes at ef2885a5 on free23, xe21 and xe18: each ran all 716 rows over stdio and HTTP (w4_runtime_issue47_killed_session_dml_not_replayed passed and later profile-variant cases continued), reaching the final manifest gate. No lane printed 'failed to drop before profile switch'. Fix commit: 04008004 (close and reinitialize the client after kill_served_session_dml_user; reset tracked profile and level).

limitations: The full lanes are still red overall: 18 rel012 manifest scenarios are missing (oraclemcp-bb5qm), and w4_runtime_issue46_scn_probe_cached, w4_query_cte_read and w4_query_issue35_trusted_view_function_refused fail on all lanes (plus two lane-specific rows). This bead claims only removing the profile-switch abort, so the advisory FREE23 W4 CI lane is not green yet.
